thread:
ada: quick postmortem note 10: several teams reported being inundated with notifications during the tenant-slice rollout yesterday. looks like per-node webhooks + email were firing for each shard apply.

marc: saw that in #support. users got duplicated alerts because preview and apply phases both emitted the same severity. not great.

riley: current pipeline: every apply emits `cfg.propagation.step` with shard_id and node_id. notifier fans that out. short term we can throttle but we should design a cleaner model.

priya: requirements: 1) keep immutable audit events 2) avoid noisy ops channels 3) surface critical failures immediately.

ada: (typo) meant ada: +4: agree with priya. propose a new event attribute `notify_mode` with values `full|compact|silent_summary`. default `full` for now.

marc: semantics: `full` = today's behavior; `compact` = dedupe by shard and node, and rate-limit per-minute; `silent_summary` = only `cfg.propagation.summary` at end.

riley: technical: add `propagation_batch_id` (uuid) and `phase` (`preview`/`apply`/`final`). notifier can use batch_id to aggregate and produce a single digest. also add `escalation_on` list of error codes that always bypass suppression.

priya: console UX: rollout modal needs a dropdown "Notification mode" with inline help: "Compact will reduce per-node noise; Summary emits one digest when rollout completes. Critical errors still escalate." product ok?

marc: product check: yep, they'd like an "estimated deliveries" metric on the preview screen so teams see how many emails/webhooks they'd trigger under each mode. helps default decisions.

riley: we'll sample historical shard counts to estimate recipients. add field `notification_estimate` to preview API. also expose `estimated_critical_count`.

ada: ada again: API shape suggestion: POST /v1/configs/:id/propagate?notify_mode=compact&escalate=true and body: {"targets": [...], "stages": [{"pct":5},{"pct":100}], "propagation_batch_id": "<uuid>"}

marc: include example in docs:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs/678/propagate?notify_mode=silent_summary&escalate=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"targets": ["acct:acme"], "stages": [{"pct": 10},{"pct":100}], "propagation_batch_id":"b3c9-..."}'
```

riley: notifier work: add a new channel `rollout-digest` that teams can subscribe to. digest payload should include: batch_id, phase, totals (applied/failed/errored), top 5 error samples, and links to per-tenant logs. digest should be actionable (button to open failed tenant trace).

priya: oncall safety: `compact` should still send immediate alerts for errors with severity >= P1 or specific exception classes. config should list the classes. default `escalate=true` to preserve existing SLOs.

ada: ops-bot: automated note 17763456890 config.propagation.batch_created batch=b3c9 user=ada env=prod

marc: next steps: riley to spec event + proto changes and migration window; priya to draft modal copy and preview mock with estimate; ada to update the rollout runbook and notify SRE; i'll own docs changes. aim for next sprint.

riley: will include compatibility: accept old `cfg.propagation.step` for 14 days and emit synthetic summaries for a short window to avoid gaps.

priya: copy for modal: "Notification mode: Full (all events), Compact (reduces per-node noise), Summary (single digest after completion). Critical errors always notify immediately unless opted out)."

ada: thanks all 44d let's track in the RFC board.
